content.what_it_is: MATLAB short-channel vessel morphology plotter. It mirrors dep_00001 into a 2n-1 grid (L2-L35), configures a three-panel layout for output index 20 (L18-L40), loads/masks/mirrors eta and concentration plus suspended/bedload depth changes, sums the two change components, and plots eta/log concentration/total change (L42-L105). It then plots cross-shore mean total bed change and the mirrored initial depth section (L108-L126); no file output is issued.
unresolved: CH is masked for dry cells but not constrained positive (L51,L57,L79); wet zeros become -Inf under log10 and negative/sentinel values become non-real/NaN, with no floor supporting caxis [0,0.5].
Neither suspended nor bedload change is masked (L46-L47,L59-L65), so BB and its mean may include dry/sentinel cells while eta/concentration panels hide them.

The time label array `min={'40'}` is unused because its only title is commented at L82; it also shadows MATLAB's min built-in. The single frame overwrites loop arrays, so a future multi-frame list would leave section plots based only on the final frame.
No print/save call exists, so the script produces only interactive figures. Field shapes and fixed axes are unvalidated.
